# S2 audience dossier — VERBATIM LANGUAGE (fixture)

> FIXTURE. A minimal stand-in for a real S2 dossier, so assertion #0 (ENTRY) and Rule C's
> verbatim check have something to resolve against. A real dossier is mined from forums,
> reviews, interviews and the inbox, and carries a source quote per phrase.
>
> The phrases below are deliberately in the AUDIENCE's register, not ours. The register IS
> the keyword: real people type "ayurvedic medicine for anxiety", not "anxiolytic botanical
> therapeutics", and they type "ashwagandha ke fayde", not "benefits of ashwagandha".
> Paraphrasing the audience into tidy marketing English destroys the only thing this layer
> is for.
>
> HONEST GAP, stated rather than papered over: Ahrefs' published seed method #4 is "review
> communities and forums — Reddit, Quora". reddit.com and old.reddit.com are both BLOCKED to
> this agent's user agent (HTTP 400: domain not accessible). We have banned the head-brainstorm
> (method #1) precisely because provenance is the only defence, and we are simultaneously
> locked out of the authority-endorsed substitute for it. For an encyclopedia whose audience
> argues in forums, K2's supply is genuinely thin until Q4 closes. This dossier's verbatim
> layer is therefore PARTIAL, and says so rather than pretending otherwise.
